Name: More Spouse Events
Author: FernandoFec
Description:
This mod focusses on adding more events for marriage candidates. I will try to maintain the characters' personalities as similar to vanilla as possible though the dialogue might be a bit sappy cause I am a sucker for romance. :P

Attention: The dialogue may sometimes be slightly suggestive although not explicit. It is recommended that you are a bit older (if anyone who plays the event has a suggestion of recommended age do also let me know ¯\_(ツ)_/¯)

My final goal is to add 3-8 events for each candidate in specific categories (12 hearts, kids, festival, rival, renewing vows, Argument at low hearts, their and the player's birthday), tho I do not know when I will finish and how it will work out as it will depend on me coming up with new ideas for events and the limitations of my modding skills. If you have any suggestions for event ideas you can fill out this form [url=https://forms.gle/jbPb22mcSt9VNWwn7]https://forms.gle/jbPb22mcSt9VNWwn7[/url] feel free to submit as many ideas as you want, tho I can't promise I will actually do them as it will depend on whether I can expand on it and the events I am missing for each character (If you do submit something please give details on what they are doing/talking about).
